Adult Muay Thai & more

Adult Muay Thai

Explore Muay Thai training and an introductory lesson for new adult students. Find out how the programme is introduced and which current sessions fit your enquiry. Ask about the first lesson, what to bring and how the academy recommends arranging your start.

Strength & conditioning

Begin with an individual assessment and explore the gym’s strength classes. Explore the programme information and ask about the introductory assessment. Talk through your training interests and confirm the current class options directly with the academy.

Youth Muay Thai

Discover the youth Muay Thai program for ages nine to fourteen. Parents can use the programme information as a starting point for questions about age groups, sessions and getting started. Confirm the current intake and first-visit arrangements with the academy.

Quick Start trials

Review the current trial options, schedules and intake information before getting started. Check the academy website for current trial details, then ask which option fits the programme you want to explore. Confirm the session and any preparation directly before attending.

A first class. A fresh chapter.

8 Limbs Academy is a Philadelphia Muay Thai and strength gym. New students begin with a Quick Start trial, with separate pathways for adult Muay Thai, strength and conditioning, and youth Muay Thai. Explore the gym and meet its coaches on the official website.

Some people arrive with a training routine. Others arrive ready to try something completely new. Start with what interests you and the programme you want to explore. The academy’s different training pathways make it possible to ask a more specific question about where to begin.

Find the kind of training that draws you in.

The academy gives adult Muay Thai, strength and conditioning, and youth Muay Thai their own pathways. Your first step is to explore the one that interests you. From there, the current Quick Start information can guide a conversation with the team about beginning.

Muay Thai, strength and conditioning, and youth training serve different interests. Think about the sessions you want to learn more about and the questions you have around getting started. The current programme information and trial details on the academy website are the place to explore those options.

Find your own reason to show up.

Some questions are about the bigger picture. Others are about the practical details. Give both a little room before getting in touch with 8 Limbs Academy. A clear starting point leaves more space for the conversation you actually want to have.

Your interests

Choose the part of training you want to explore first. A clear interest makes it easier to ask about the programme, the coaching approach and the current ways to get started.

Your starting point

Let the academy know whether you are new to training or bringing experience with you. Ask the questions that will make your first visit feel more familiar.

Your routine

Look at the current schedule and consider which sessions fit your week. Confirm the trial or introductory route before making plans around a particular class.

Turn curiosity into a first conversation.

A first enquiry can be simple: explain which programme interests you, whether you have trained before and what you would like to know about a first visit. Ask the academy to confirm its current trial route, schedule and any preparation needed for the session you arrange.

You can be curious without having your whole training routine worked out. Pick the programme you want to explore and ask the questions that matter for your first session. The next step is the one you arrange with the academy.

A little preparation.
A clearer next step.

There is room to explore before you decide. Start with the part that interests you, take your questions with you and connect directly with 8 Limbs Academy when you are ready.

  1. Explore a programme

    Read about adult Muay Thai, strength and conditioning or youth Muay Thai. Pick the pathway that interests you and note the questions you want to ask the academy.

  2. Check the current trial

    Use the website to review the Quick Start options and programme details. Ask how to book, which session to attend and what the first visit involves.

  3. Make your first visit

    Confirm the session, location and anything you need to bring directly with the academy. Start with the arrangement the team has confirmed for your chosen programme.

Before you
take the next step.

A few useful starting points. For current appointments, availability and individual questions, connect with 8 Limbs Academy through its own website.

Where should a new student begin?

The academy lists Quick Start trials for new enquiries. Review the current options and contact the team to confirm the appropriate start for your programme.

Is there a youth programme?

The source information lists youth Muay Thai for ages nine to fourteen. Parents should confirm current intake, session details and any requirements directly with the academy.

Where can I check the timetable?

Use the academy website for current schedule information. Confirm the session and booking arrangements with the team before attending your first class.
